seen_animation: Frame 1: a very small boat drawing sits low at left-center just above the ground line, under tree trunks and bushes. Frames 2-4: the boat, now full size, rises into the air pitched steeply nose-up toward the upper left, climbing and moving slightly right, with its stern spray lines trailing at the lower right. Frames 5-7: it levels out while still airborne, moving left above the bush line. Frames 8-10: the nose tips down toward the lower left and the hull descends, the nose touching the water line in frame 10. Frames 11-15: the boat lies flat on the water, sliding left from center to the left edge (frames 11-13) and then holding around left-center (14-15), with a heavy black V-shaped mark at the bow in frames 11-14 and spray strokes at the stern. The tree scenery thins out and disappears, leaving a bush line on the horizon. Frame 16: the boat is smaller and further up the frame, moving away on open water.
seen_film: Frame 1: a dark object (the boat) is barely visible at left behind a dock among moss-hung cypress trees. Frames 2-4: a speedboat launches over the dock, nose high and tilted up-left, rising. Frames 5-7: it is fully airborne, levelling out, people visible on board, moving left past the trees. Frames 8-10: the nose drops toward the water at the lower left and touches down in frame 10. Frames 11-15: the boat hits the lake and skims left with a tall white spray plume rising behind it; trees fall away to open water and a far tree line. Frame 16: the boat moves away, smaller, with the spray settling.
named_subject: a speedboat (motorboat with cabin windows and stern spray), drawn as the doodle
evidence: Positions and attitudes match the film frame for frame: frame 1 small boat at left-center where the film's boat is half-hidden behind the dock; frames 2-4 nose-up climb at the same up-left angle and location as film 2-4; frames 5-7 level flight across the left half as in film 5-7; frames 8-10 nose-down descent with the nose touching the water in frame 10 exactly as film 10; frames 11-15 flat skim to the left with the trees leaving the frame as in film 11-15; frame 16 smaller boat receding as in film 16. The boat keeps the doodle's hull outline, three windows and stern spray strokes in every frame. Judged from still frames only, not playback.
primary_gap: In frames 11-15 the film's tall white spray plume at the moment of landing is missing, and instead a heavy black V-shaped spike sits at the bow in frames 11-14, which reads as a stray mark rather than water.
closes_when: Frames 11-15 show the water splash drawn in light, doodle-weight strokes rising behind the boat as in the film, and the black V spike at the bow is removed or redrawn at the same line weight as the rest of the drawing.
protect: The frame-accurate path and attitude of the boat (nose-up launch 2-4, level flight 5-7, nose-down touchdown 10, left skim 11-15, recession 16); the doodle's hull outline, three windows and stern spray strokes kept intact while rotating; the scenery transition from trees to open water in step with the film.
identity_gap: The boat is the doodle's own drawing throughout; only the added heavy black V at the bow in frames 11-14 departs from the doodle's line weight and stroke habits.
